Choose any time in Pakistan Standard Time. Default: 11:00 AM PKT.
The first-Thursday date remains automatic. Calendar sources may update after moon sightings; the selected reminder time is saved.

Choose a Pakistani city for an approximate Maghrib date change. Automatic mode uses existing opt-in weather location when available; otherwise the displayed Hijri date is a civil-date estimate. This does not certify a moon sighting.
